evidence.description: ISO8601DateFormatter is instantiated inside the function body.

candidates.explanation: The ISO8601DateFormatter is instantiated every time lastUpdatedDate() is called. DateFormatters are expensive to create and should be reused or stored as a static property.
candidates.title: Inefficient DateFormatter instantiation

evidence.description: Manual guard and formatter instantiation for date conversion.

candidates.explanation: The code manually checks for the existence of a date string and then creates a formatter to parse it, which is less efficient than using a single optional mapping or a pre-configured formatter.
candidates.title: Redundant Date conversion logic

candidates.explanation: The use of hardcoded Unix timestamps (e.g., 1604671200) makes the code difficult to maintain and less readable compared to using Date components.
candidates.title: Hardcoded date values
